english.title: Fail to control / place / carry / remove luggage / an article on the Croydon Tramlink system as requested
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who had brought

(A)_[luggage, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LUGGAGE..),]_
(B)_[an article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),]_

onto a

(C)_[tram, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAM..),]_
(D)_[tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP..),]_

on the Croydon Tramlink system failed to

(E)_[control or place it in such a way as to minimise, so far as was reasonably practicable, any obstruction, unnecessary inconvenience or danger to a person]_
(F)_[carry, control or place it in accordance with conditions of travel or with Croydon Tramlick byelaws or directions given by an authorised officer]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 16 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
